name: MeUndies
sale_pattern: Lower member pricing; clearance is final sale
notes: meundies.com answered HTTP 429 with a Vercel bot challenge (x-vercel-mitigated: challenge) to WebFetch and curl on 2026-10-29; not read, no workaround. No prices recorded: prices only come from the brand's own store. Human check.

Status set from the brand's official help center (help.meundies.com, served 2026-10-29), which describes current ordering, shipping and returns, and from target.com, which listed 45 MeUndies products (men's UltraModal Core boxer briefs, trunks, boxers; women's FeelFree briefs and bralettes; kids' packs) on 2026-10-29.
Help center, What size undies are right for me?: 'MeUndies offer a huge size pool that starts from XS up until 4XL.*' with '* Prints and styles that offer size 4XL varies'.

Help center, What's the difference between our undies?: Core is MicroModal with a black waistband; FeelFree is the same Modal without the black waistband; FeelFree Lace has a lace waistband; All Over Lace uses recycled nylon and spandex; Breathe (formerly MoveMe) uses nylon and spandex; Seamless (formerly DreamSeam) lies flat to avoid lines. Target listings call the fabric UltraModal.

Help center, How much does shipping cost?: members get free US shipping on every order; non-members free over $75, otherwise $7.95 standard or $25 expedited. Flat rates: Canada $12, UK $10, Australia and New Zealand $16, EU $16, other international $38 (USD), DDP.

Help center, Where do you ship?: ships from San Bernardino, CA to 'everywhere in the world*' except listed restricted countries; not currently shipping to Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guatemala, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, Portugal, Spain, Taiwan or Iceland.

Help center, What is your return policy?: full refund within 45 days; underwear unworn and unwashed; refunds only, no exchanges; Mystery Packs and clearance are final sale; free returns for domestic orders only. Returns address in San Bernardino, CA, which the page calls 'our HQ address' (basis for hq_country US).
Help center, How long should my order take to arrive?: 1–2 business days to ship, then 3–10 business days within the US; Canada, Australia and New Zealand 1–2 weeks.

Help center, Membership articles: cancel from Account Info > Subscriptions > Manage Membership, which also offers skip a month or an extended pause; after cancelling, 'our products will return to their original price'.
Help center, referral program: $25 credit per successful referral; referred new customers get 40% off a first order of $12 or more (excludes packs and gift cards).
